artifacts.note: Engineering vertical slice: adaptive loop beats static and random under simulation. Not a human efficacy result.
Historical pilot gate (2/6 passes). Its VALIDATED label is not canonical; P2R establishes that the confirmatory cohort was not executed.
Spatial-provenance blocker; resolved in method, not in data.
Canonical: confirmatory compute blocked; 1/6 subjects preprocessed; no neural outcome computed. Imagery remains unauthorized.

Planning check for N=180 with 2,000 simulations. Power for true ICC 0.75 with lower 95% bound above 0.60 is 0.961 under a normal approximation. Not human evidence; the registered analysis will use the actual ICC confidence-interval method.

Stage 0 simulation with 120 simulated participants and 120 trials each. Parameter recovery passed (bias +0.051, RMSE 0.197). Adaptive EIG reduced final posterior entropy by 28.9% versus the fixed stratified schedule. This is a design artifact, not human evidence.
Planning check for N=180 with 2,000 simulations. Power for true ICC 0.75 with lower 95% bound above 0.60 is 0.961 under a normal approximation. Not human evidence.

Policy-parameter recovery with 60 simulated participants and 80 trials. Beta bias -0.131, lambda bias -0.035, tau bias -0.025. Conditional on the known EIG feature matrix; not a human validation and not a full hierarchical recovery.

Stage 0B simulation with 120 simulated participants and 120 trials, four cards and at most two samples per trial. Mean accuracy 0.458, mean ARTE 0.444, and mean queries 1.79. This is a design artifact, not human evidence.

Simulated Beta-Binomial calibration with 40 participants and 20 trials per source-test cell. Four tests retain a strong seen-versus-imagined likelihood ratio; the fluency trap remains non-diagnostic. A human calibration sample is still required before confirmatory data.

Dual-hypothesis prediction with 24 simulated participants and 60 trials. Mean perceived diagnosticity is 0.476, but dual prediction does not improve accuracy over single prediction on the fixed sequence (gain 0.0). The counterfactual label is not yet earned; the construct remains prospective reality testing.
Simulation-based planning surface for the prediction contrast, false-seen assay, and reliability. A REVIEW means the current design must not be registered as confirmatory.

Assay-validation artifact. Sensitivity is established against an injected 5pp effect. The readout-only model is null with b_pi=0; a separate b_pi=0.4 run shows a model-predicted prediction-consistency bias. Human distortion remains a testable misspecification question.

Simulated person-by-occasion variance components and four-point decision study. Relative reliability is 0.938 at two occasions; the occasion component is zero in this draw. The N=240 power check for true ICC 0.80 and lower bound 0.70 is 0.949. These are planning illustrations, not human reliability estimates.

Full hierarchical SBC for the Stage 1D paired false-seen endpoint, not a trial-level CRT model. 1,000 prior draws; primary mean rank 0.505, coverage 0.936, chi-square 7.12; second endpoint mean rank 0.491, coverage 0.954, chi-square 5.52. Model recovery balanced accuracy 0.855. No human evidence.
Conditional group-mean recovery screening with participant-level pi variation. It is not joint hierarchical SBC and does not recover M3/M4; full hierarchical validation remains required.

Hierarchical endpoint recovery for M0/M2/M3/M4 parameterizations. Balanced accuracy 0.855, just above the 0.85 threshold; M3/M4 confusions are non-trivial. These are endpoint models, not the Stage 0D theory models.

Stage 0E oracle audit with 24 simulated participants and 60 trials. Oracle prediction advantage is 0.128 versus 0.026 under belief-based prediction, an oracle inflation of 0.101. The source is updated from the outcome only. Nested posterior PIT calibration passes (chi-square 15.92, critical 21.67). The historical oracle specificity gate is downgraded separately.

Policy competition with 24 simulated participants and 60 trials. Meta-EIG exceeds cost-only by 0.060, but the best competing policy exceeds meta-EIG by 0.012. The normative meta-EIG claim is descriptive only (LIMITED).
Planning check for N=180 with 2,000 simulations. Power for true ICC 0.75 with lower 95% bound above 0.60 is 0.961 under a normal approximation. Not human evidence.
Stage 0F design-integrity audit. It resolves the 120/240 trial arithmetic, moves the primary prediction contrast to the yoked comparison, and labels the active contrast as a package effect.
Simulated test-facet reliability with 60 participants, six tests, and two occasions. Minimum relative reliability is 0.843 and mean is 0.863. This is a design check, not a human reliability estimate.

Policy, prediction-precision, and imagination-inflation recovery with 60 simulated participants and 120 trials. Policy parameters and prediction precision recover within tolerance (beta bias -0.016, lambda bias -0.033, tau bias 0.227, pi bias -0.010). The imagination-inflation parameter is secondary and has a 0.105 RMSE; it is not a clinical process estimate. Not a human validation.

Conditional recovery audit for the repaired readout. pi is recovered with fixed d, guessing, and response bias; conditional SBC uses 200 simulated participants over a uniform pi prior; M0 versus M2 is compared by BIC. This is design identifiability evidence, not human evidence and not full hierarchical SBC.

Stage 0G registration-readiness summary. BLOCKED is expected until the full joint CRT source/policy POMDP SBC, model-based power, calibration, independent review, and ethics are complete. The trial-level readout SBC passes but recovery is REVIEW. It does not authorize human data.

Stage 0C simulation with 120 simulated participants and 120 trials across the four CRT cells plus the observe baseline. The prospective-prediction contrast is positive and counterfactual-discrimination efficiency is high. The active-versus-yoked calibration contrast is near zero under matched-sequence yoking, so the active-selection claim is not supported by this artifact. Design evidence only; not human validation.

Historical Stage 0D specificity/selection artifact generated with oracle prediction. Preserved unmodified. Stage 0E did not reproduce the diagnostic-specificity advantage under belief-based prediction, so this artifact is superseded and its PASS is not a current claim.

Belief-based re-analysis of the Stage 0D diagnostic-specificity control. Diagnostic prediction accuracy is 0.505 and the source accuracy gain is 0.026 (0.400 vs 0.374), below the pre-specified prediction accuracy floor of 0.55. The specificity claim is downgraded to LIMITED.
Paired normal approximation at N=480/d=0.20 (power 0.90 in this run). It must be rechecked with the trial-level model-based endpoint before registration.

Offline maximin model-discrimination screening. A PASS requires power >=0.90 and minimum pairwise balanced accuracy >=0.85. It selects a trial composition; it is not a hypothesis test or human evidence.
BIC recovery among pre-specified full joint models. A PASS requires balanced accuracy >=0.85. Simulation identifiability, not evidence that humans use a model.
Full joint latent-source SBC with observed test choice. It is not the policy POMDP; a PASS is simulation calibration only.
Stage 0H model-space declaration. M0-M7 with M0/M2/M4/M6/M7 confirmatory; M1/M3/M5 exploratory. A declaration is not evidence for any model.
Stage 0H readiness summary. BLOCKED is expected until the computational gates, adversarial review, calibration, registration, and ethics are complete. It does not authorize human data.
Full-joint-model design screen. A PASS requires the complete confirmatory model set and minimum pairwise recovery above threshold; it is design evidence, not human evidence.
BIC recovery across all confirmatory latent-source models. A PASS is simulation identifiability, not evidence that humans use a model.
Laplace parameter SBC for all confirmatory latent-source models. A PASS is screening calibration, not NUTS and not human evidence.
Simulation-only pairwise full-model identifiability. A PASS requires all confirmatory models and uncertainty lower bounds above the pre-specified threshold; it is not human evidence.
Optional NumPyro/JAX readiness check. BLOCKED means the publication-grade posterior backend is unavailable; Laplace remains screening-only and cannot satisfy a confirmatory gate.

Stage 0I readiness summary. BLOCKED is expected until computational gates, independent review, adversarial agreement, calibration, registration, and ethics are complete. It never authorizes human collection.
Laplace approximate continuous-parameter SBC for the meta-EIG policy's temperature, cost, and positive-testing parameters. It is not NUTS and not human evidence.
Policy-choice recovery in simulation. A PASS is identifiability evidence for the policy layer, not evidence that humans use a policy.
Discrete policy-model calibration, not continuous-parameter SBC. A PASS means the simulated policy is selected above threshold; it does not show that participants use that policy.
Source-integrity audit for Stage 0I. A PASS means cited DOI/PMID metadata and status were checked and the Corcoran et al. role was corrected; it is not a systematic review or priority claim.
Pilot-to-target normal projection of full-model BIC separation. Both PASS and REVIEW map to LIMITED because this is not a target-scale fit or target-scale SBC.

N=432/T=240 single-replicate hierarchical readout design screen using the combined vividness/confidence manipulation. Both outcomes map to LIMITED because this is not a full joint-model fit, not SBC, and not human evidence.

Stage 0D signature-separability analysis with five competing models and 0.03 measurement noise. Balanced accuracy 0.90; the weakest diagonal is the heuristic model at 0.775. This is design evidence, not human model evidence.
BIC-based effect-conditioned recovery among the pre-specified confirmatory readout models M0/M2/M4. M1/M3/M5 remain exploratory. It is a readout-family check, not the full CRT theory tournament.
Trial-level hierarchical readout SBC. Scope string is trial_level_hierarchical_readout_not_full_crt_pomdp. It is a validation step, not the full CRT source/policy model.
Null on incremental behavioural validity; mechanism unresolved because temporal and channel controls reproduce the effect.
Null content and transfer result within sensitivity; compact architectures at or below chance under LOSO.
Perception decoding passes; zero-shot imagery transfer is null within sensitivity; reconstruction readiness blocked.
Earlier real-data decision blocked by unresolved imagery row provenance. Preserved unmodified; superseded after the NSD row mapping was resolved.
Cross-session alignment restores seen-image decoding but imagery remains degenerate (dominant fraction 0.510). Single subject, not population evidence.
Execution-incomplete blocker; superseded by the completed run.
Perception-estimand blocker; superseded by the completed run.
One of six subjects passes; C3XAG preparation is not authorized. This is a limited result, not a validation.

claims.uncertainty: No test-retest, convergent, or known-groups validation in humans

claims.statement: The epistemic interview reconstructs probe-variable beliefs with reported uncertainty, not a picture of what a person imagined.

gates.name: Neural-behavioural alignment
gates.note: Null on incremental validity; mechanism unresolved.

gates.name: Neural content and state disentanglement
gates.note: Null content and transfer within sensitivity.

gates.name: Zero-shot imagery transfer
gates.note: Perception passes; imagery transfer null.

gates.name: Cross-session alignment mechanism
gates.note: Alignment works for seen images; imagery remains degenerate.

gates.name: Atlas imagery qualification (replication 1)
gates.note: 1/6 subject pass; C3XAG not authorized.

gates.name: ANIMUS closed-loop vertical slice
gates.note: Engineering pass under simulation; not a human validation.

gates.name: Perception decoder confirmation
gates.note: Confirmatory compute blocked; pilot only.

gates.name: Source-monitoring Stage 0 simulation
gates.note: Simulation-only design gate for the Source and Imagination Monitor. A PASS means parameter recovery and the coverage constraints are acceptable in simulation; it is not human validation and does not authorize a measurement claim.

gates.name: Source-monitoring Stage 1 power check
gates.note: Simulation-only planning gate. A PASS means the planned N=180 has at least 80% power for the reliability lower-bound target under the stated approximation; it is not human evidence.

gates.name: Active Reality Testing Stage 0B simulation
gates.note: Simulation-only design gate. A PASS means the EIG agent is above chance and its query choices are efficient under the stated model; it is not human validation and does not authorize a measurement claim.

gates.name: Active Reality Testing Stage 2 power check
gates.note: Simulation-only planning gate. A PASS means N=180 has at least 80% power for the ARTE reliability lower-bound target under the stated approximation; it is not human evidence.

gates.name: Active Reality Testing policy recovery
gates.note: Simulation-only model-recovery gate. A PASS means the policy parameters are recovered within the stated tolerance conditional on the known EIG feature matrix; it does not validate the task or the full hierarchical measurement model.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0C simulation
gates.note: Simulation-only design gate. A PASS means the prospective-prediction contrast and the meta-EIG policy clear the stated thresholds in simulation; it is not human validation and does not authorize a measurement claim. A REVIEW preserves the prediction contrast as provisional and blocks the active-selection claim.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing policy and precision recovery
gates.note: Simulation-only recovery gate. A PASS means policy, prediction-precision, and imagination-inflation parameters are recovered within the stated tolerance under the Stage 0C fixed-parameter conditions; it does not validate the task or the human analysis model.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 1 power check
gates.note: Simulation-only planning gate. A PASS means N=180 has at least 80% power for the reliability lower-bound target under the stated approximation; it is not human evidence.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0D model-signature separability
gates.note: Simulation-only design-identifiability gate. A PASS means the five competing theory signatures are separable under the stated measurement noise. It is not a fit to human data and does not establish that any model is true.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing specificity and active-selection controls
gates.note: Simulation-only control gate, now canonicalized on belief-based prediction. The historical oracle artifact is preserved but superseded; Stage 0E showed that the diagnostic-specificity advantage did not reproduce when the participant predicted from the current source posterior. The current status is LIMITED. Not human evidence.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing belief-based prediction repair
gates.note: Simulation-only model-repair gate. A PASS means oracle inflation is quantified, the belief arm predicts from the current source posterior, the source is updated from the outcome only, and the nested posterior PIT calibration check passes. A PASS is design evidence, not human validation and not authorization for a measurement claim.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing belief-readout recovery and conditional SBC
gates.note: Simulation-only identifiability gate for the repaired belief readout. A PASS requires conditional parameter recovery of pi (relative RMSE, bias, correlation), a uniform conditional SBC rank histogram, and above-threshold recovery of M0 versus M2. d, guessing, and response bias are fixed; this is not full hierarchical SBC and not human evidence.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing dual-hypothesis prediction
gates.note: Simulation-only construct gate. A PASS requires dual diagnostic prediction to improve accuracy over a single prediction and a dual non-diagnostic prediction on the same test sequence. A REVIEW means the counterfactual label is not yet earned; the construct remains prospective reality testing.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing policy competition
gates.note: Simulation-only policy gate. A PASS requires meta-EIG selection to exceed both cost-only and the best competing policy. A REVIEW means the normative meta-EIG claim is descriptive only.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing test-facet reliability
gates.note: Simulation-only test-facet reliability gate. A PASS means every simulated test facet clears the pre-specified relative-reliability floor at two occasions. It is not a human reliability estimate.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing generalizability decision study
gates.note: Simulation-only variance-component and decision-study gate. A PASS means the simulated person variance supports the stated relative-reliability target at two occasions; it is not an estimate of human reliability.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing test-likelihood calibration design
gates.note: Simulation-only calibration gate. A PASS means at least four tests have a strong simulated seen-versus-imagined likelihood ratio and the fluency trap remains non-diagnostic. A human calibration sample must freeze the likelihood table before confirmatory data collection.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0F protocol integrity
gates.note: Design-integrity gate for the Stage 0F protocol. A PASS requires consistent trial arithmetic, a yoked primary prediction contrast, a labelled active package contrast, six tests, the fluency trap, and a session duration within the 75-minute cap. It does not authorize human collection.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0F design power
gates.note: Simulation-only planning gate. A PASS requires at least 90% power for the stated smallest effect of interest, 80% for the false-seen distortion assay, and 80% for the reliability lower bound. A REVIEW means the current N/trial design is not adequately powered and must not be registered as confirmatory.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0F distortion assay
gates.note: Simulation-only assay-validation gate. A PASS means the paired false-seen assay detects an injected 5-percentage-point shift with at least 80% power while the b_pi=0 readout-only model remains null. A separate b_pi>0 run illustrates a model-predicted bias channel. It does not show that dual prediction causes distortion in humans.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0F hierarchical recovery screening
gates.note: Conditional group-mean screening with participant-level pi variation. A PASS is screening evidence only; it is not joint hierarchical SBC and does not recover M3/M4. The endpoint-level hierarchical SBC is reported separately; the trial-level CRT model remains outstanding.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0F endpoint hierarchical SBC
gates.note: Full hierarchical Bayes for the Stage 1D paired false-seen endpoint (group means, between-person SD, participant-level differences, known binomial SEs), with 1,000 prior draws. A PASS means the endpoint rank histogram is calibrated and 95% coverage is in range. It is not a trial-level CRT source-monitoring SBC.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0F endpoint model recovery
gates.note: Hierarchical endpoint recovery among four parameterizations: no format effect (M0), common format effect (M2), dual-specific effect (M3), and dual plus nondiagnostic-demand effect (M4). A PASS requires balanced accuracy >=0.85. These are endpoint models, not the Stage 0D theory models.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0G design power
gates.note: Planning approximation at N=480 and d=0.20. A PASS requires at least 90% power for the primary yoked contrast. It is not trial-level model power and is not human evidence.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0G trial-level SBC
gates.note: Trial-level hierarchical readout SBC with participant random effects and condition effects. A PASS means the target condition-effect ranks/coverage are calibrated for the readout model. It is not the full CRT source-monitoring POMDP and does not authorize human collection.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0G trial-level model recovery
gates.note: BIC-based effect-conditioned recovery among the confirmatory M0/M2/M4 readout models; M1/M3/M5 are exploratory. A PASS requires balanced accuracy >=0.85. It validates the readout model family, not the full CRT theory tournament.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0H model space
gates.note: Declares M0-M7 and the confirmatory M0/M2/M4/M6/M7 set. A PASS means the model space and exploratory labels are explicit; it is not evidence for any model.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0H design optimization
gates.note: Offline screening of trial compositions for model discrimination under a power floor. A PASS means a candidate reaches the discrimination and power thresholds; it is not human evidence and the classifier used to rank candidates is not a hypothesis test.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0H full-model SBC
gates.note: Full joint latent-source SBC with observed test choice. A PASS means the declared target parameters are calibrated for this likelihood; it is not the policy POMDP or human evidence.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0H full-model recovery
gates.note: BIC recovery among the pre-specified full joint models. A PASS requires balanced accuracy >=0.85 under the recorded simulation conditions; it is identifiability evidence only.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0H readiness
gates.note: Documentation-quality gate. BLOCKED is expected until computational gates, adversarial review, calibration, registration, and ethics are complete. It never authorizes human collection.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0I source integrity
gates.note: Source metadata and correction audit. A PASS means the cited DOI/PMID records and the Corcoran role correction were checked; it is not a systematic review.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0I inference backend
gates.note: Optional NumPyro/JAX readiness. BLOCKED means confirmatory posterior inference is not installed; Laplace remains approximate and cannot pass a confirmatory gate.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0I identifiability
gates.note: Simulation-only pairwise full-model recovery. A PASS requires all confirmatory models and lower uncertainty bounds above threshold; it is not human evidence.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0I design optimization
gates.note: Full-joint-model design screen. A PASS requires the complete confirmatory set and minimum pairwise recovery above threshold; it is design evidence, not a hypothesis test.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0I target readout design
gates.note: N=432/T=240 single-replicate hierarchical readout screen with the combined manipulation. It is not a full joint-model fit, SBC, or human evidence, so both PASS and REVIEW map to LIMITED.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0I target design projection
gates.note: Pilot full-model BIC separation projected to N=432/T=240 by a normal approximation. It is a planning projection, not a target-scale fit, target-scale SBC, or human evidence.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0I policy calibration
gates.note: Discrete policy-model calibration, not continuous-parameter SBC. It does not show that humans use the policy.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0I policy parameter SBC
gates.note: Laplace approximate SBC for meta-EIG policy parameters. It is not NUTS and does not establish that participants use the policy.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0I full-model SBC
gates.note: Laplace SBC for all confirmatory latent-source models. A PASS is screening calibration, not NUTS.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0I full-model recovery
gates.note: BIC recovery across all confirmatory latent-source models. A PASS is simulation identifiability, not human evidence.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0I policy recovery
gates.note: Policy-choice recovery in simulation. A PASS is policy identifiability, not human evidence.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing Stage 0I readiness
gates.note: Documentation-quality readiness gate. BLOCKED is expected until computational gates, independent review, adversarial agreement, calibration, registration, and ethics are complete.

gates.name: Counterfactual Reality Testing registration readiness
gates.note: Documentation-quality gate. READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW means the Stage 0F package is complete enough for PI, statistician, adversarial, and ethics review; it does not authorize human data collection or upgrade any claim. BLOCKED means at least one prerequisite is missing. Endpoint SBC is complete and a trial-level readout SBC is reported, but trial-level readout recovery is a post hoc conditional pass (LIMITED), not a pre-specified full-set pass; the full CRT POMDP SBC, calibration, model-based power, independent review, and ethics remain blockers.
